title: Find Large iPhone Videos Before Choosing What to Compress
description: Find large videos on iPhone before choosing which to compress. Review the source, check a smaller copy and understand what actually frees storage.
direct: Find the large videos first, then decide which are worth compressing. A long clip is not always the largest: duration, resolution and encoding settings all affect file size.
figureAlt: Different video subjects form a review shortlist before checking file sizes and choosing what to compress.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot or measured export.
cards.decision.heading: Make the first check
cards.decision.body: Start in Settings, General, iPhone Storage to see whether Photos is a major contributor. The device’s recommendations can vary. Avoid deleting unrelated apps if the main problem is a small group of large recordings.
sections.detail-0-0.heading: File review comes before deletion
sections.detail-0-0.body: A large file may be an important original rather than waste. Several unrelated large videos are also a different problem from duplicate copies. Make a short review list and work through it; do not assume that the first large result is safe to remove.
sections.detail-1-0.heading: Check what actually changes storage
sections.detail-1-0.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone app. Its public listing includes large-media discovery, local compression and original-versus-export size comparison; Pro unlocks export tools. Saving a smaller copy adds another file until you make a separate retention decision.
sections.detail-1-1.heading: Limits and final checks
sections.detail-1-1.body: If iCloud Photos is enabled, Apple warns that deleting a photo or video also deletes it from other devices using that library. Keep a verified independent copy when needed. The app does not promise a particular number of gigabytes reclaimed or automatic safe deletion of every large recording.

steps.step-1.text: Open Storage Clean in Phone Cleaner: Photo & Video and review the large videos it finds. Identify the event, duration and visible contents before choosing a candidate.
steps.step-2.text: For a video you want to keep, create a compressed sharing copy with suitable settings. Keep the original while you compare the saved file sizes.
steps.step-3.text: Play the output from beginning to end, or inspect representative sections in a long recording. Check sound, orientation and important detail before deciding what to retain.
